attributes.title: 2027 Law and Ethics in Counseling Conference
attributes.series: Law and Ethics in Counseling Conference
attributes.cme_provider: National Board for Certified Counselors (ACEP No. 800)
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Law and Ethics in Counseling Conference runs February 23 to 26, 2027, in New Orleans, Louisiana, and can also be attended live online over Zoom. It is hosted by the National Board for Certified Counselors (NBCC) together with the University of Holy Cross. Just before it, on February 22 and 23, the NBCC Foundation holds its in-person Bridging the Gap Symposium; registration is offered for either event or both.

NBCC is the CE provider (ACEP No. 800). In-person attendees can earn up to 13 NBCC clock hours and virtual attendees up to 19; only sessions marked as eligible carry credit. The symposium offers up to 6.5 hours, and session recordings, available from March 8 to April 11, 2027, add further hours.

The event hotel is the Sheraton New Orleans Hotel on Canal Street, with a group rate of $209 a night through January 25, 2027. Early-bird pricing ended November 15, 2026. Standard rates for the Law and Ethics conference are $415 in person and $275 live virtual for professionals, and $295 and $155 for students; one-day and half-day in-person tickets start at $219 for professionals and $150 for students. The full session list will follow closer to the event.
